description: A base class for Drupal migration source plugins that interact with a Drupal database, providing helper methods for system data retrieval, module checks, and configuration reading.

classes.name: DrupalSqlBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for Drupal database source plugins in migration, including system data retrieval, requirement checks, and dependency management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class, sets the entity type manager, and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: getSystemData
methods.description: Retrieves and caches system table data from the Drupal database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks if required modules and versions are met for the source Drupal site.

methods.name: getModuleSchemaVersion
methods.description: Gets the schema version of a specified module from the source database.

methods.name: moduleExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific module is enabled in the source Drupal database.

methods.name: variableGet
methods.description: Reads a variable value from the source database, with fallback to default.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates plugin dependencies based on configuration constants.

methods.name: getSourceModule
methods.description: Retrieves the source module name, falling back to plugin definition.
